title: fussia capillaris
intro: Fussia capillaris, commonly known as Capillaris, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to support liver and gallbladder function, and its health benefits include improving digestion, reducing inflammation, and promoting detoxification. The therapeutic actions of Fussia capillaris include stimulating liver function, supporting immune system health, and acting as a natural diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
